test_title: PYST 117: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 17 Jan, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions I, II and III. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true even if it seems to be at variance from commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements?

**Statement:**

All cows are mammals.

All donkeys are mammals.

All mammals are animals.

**Conclusion:**

I. All donkeys are animals.

II. All animals are donkeys.

III. Some cows are donkeys.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions II and III follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8229f10e2e88d86f47c8f4c1929f41a47d4f992b94bb64d72d53b6a21094fed9.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All donkeys are animals → Follow (As all donkeys are mammals and all mammals are animals. So, as all donkeys comes in mammals which all comes in animals therefore all donkeys are animals is definitely true)

II. All animals are donkeys → **Does not **follow (As all donkeys are mammals and all mammals are animals. So, Some animals are definitely donkeys but All animals are donkeys can be possible only)

III. Some cows are donkeys → Does not follow (No definite relation given between cows and donkeys. So, it can be possible only)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows .

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only conclusion I follows**".
